summary: W&T Offshore filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amendment to its Credit Agreement, converting its revolving facility into a reserve-based revolving credit facility with an aggregate maximum of $100.0 million and an initial elected commitment and borrowing base of $50.0 million. Maturity is the earlier of July 28, 2028 and six months before the Senior Second Lien Notes mature. Semi-annual borrowing base redeterminations begin November 1, 2026. Interest is Adjusted Term SOFR, floored at 3.00%, or Base Rate plus margin. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch borrowing base and covenant headroom.
